about: sha256 goldens of assetgen's street stage (AG7): the small test city's packs (tests/conftest.py SMALL, built by the citygen CLI) and Vesper Bay's, as `assetgen.streets.build.outputs_digest` measures them (every tile pack, the parts pack and the Unreal contribution; `all` hashes them together), with the tiles of Vesper Bay that hold the most triangles. Made on the M4 Mac and confirmed on x86_64 Linux (docker image citygen-x86).
